description.zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query instance ID.

description.zh:
人体检索阈值。取值范围为0~1。

为保证检索结果的准确性，推荐设置该参数大于等于0.8。若不设置，则取值为Threshold参数的值。
description.en:
The body search threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.

To ensure the accuracy of search results, set this parameter to a value greater than or equal to 0.8. If this parameter is not specified, the value of the Threshold parameter is used.

description.zh: 检索范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
检索类型：

- 1：人脸
- 0：人体

默认为1。
description.en:
The search type. Valid values:

- 1: face
- 0: body

Default value: 1.
The URL of the image to be searched.

description.zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
人脸检索阈值。取值范围为0~1。

为保证检索结果的准确性，推荐设置该参数在0.3~0.6之间。
description.en:
The face search threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.

To ensure the accuracy of search results, set this parameter to a value between 0.3 and 0.6.

descriptions.zh:
一体化以图搜图，指在搜图时，同时检索人脸和人体特征。
> 该功能需要在V系列边缘一体机上部署人脸和人体检测算法。
descriptions.en:
Integrated image search refers to simultaneously retrieving both face and body features when searching by image.
> This feature requires the deployment of face and body detection algorithms on V-series edge devices.
